versions.changelog:
Initial release: Interactive guide for integrating MobTech FlyVerify (秒验/妙验) into HarmonyOS NEXT projects.

- Provides step-by-step workflow for integrating FlyVerify, including SDK dependency installation, required configuration in build-profile.json5/module.json5, and privacy compliance.
- Interactive Excel template assists in gathering MobTech appKey/appSecret and integration preferences.
- Ensures all configuration changes require explicit user confirmation before modifying project files.
- Details API usage and best practices for initialization, privacy policy handling, preVerify/verify, UI customizations, and error troubleshooting.
- Enforces one-question-at-a-time user interactions to streamline the guided integration process and avoid overwhelming the user.
